title: LumiVue Analysis Response
description: Shared API contract for the analysis response. This is the single source of truth used by both frontend and backend teams.

analysis_id.description: Unique identifier for this analysis run (e.g., 'demo-001', UUID)

finding.description: The finding category determined by the analysis pipeline

model_score.description: Raw DenseNet-121 model prediction score (0.0 = normal, 1.0 = pneumonia)

confidence.description: Overall confidence level computed by the confidence engine

bbox.description: Bounding box [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] of the region of interest

heatmap_available.description: Whether a Grad-CAM heatmap overlay is available

clinical_evidence.description: Clinical evidence items that support the finding
